Progressive groups stage a protest outside the Senate of the Philippines in Pasay on Tuesday, June 10, to call for the immediate start of the impeachment trial of Vice President Sara Duterte.

Senators took their oath as judges in the impeachment court today, with the reading of the Articles of Impeachment scheduled for tomorrow, June 11.

(Photos by Djenhard Yreneo Raphael Y. Sapanhila/ The Varsitarian)
